title: Mexican Poached Rhubarb with Vibrant Salsa
description: A twist on traditional Mexican flavors, this dessert combines the sweetness of rhubarb with a tangy and vibrant salsa. Perfect for a weeknight treat.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the rhubarb, cactus pear puree, and agave syrup. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender.
Meanwhile, prepare the vibrant salsa by combining the cilantro leaves, lime juice, red onion, and habanero peppers in a bowl. Stir to combine.
Once the rhubarb is tender, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly.
To serve, place a portion of the poached rhubarb on a plate, then top with a spoonful of the vibrant salsa.
